## Projects

- [APIx](https://m0nis.com/projects/apix): Daily airfare price index for India. Solo build. Python collectors on a daily cron sweep 12 DGCA-weighted routes × 5 advance-purchase windows; 24,448 fares collected. Jevons/Young index engine reproduces MoSPI's four published worked examples to four decimal places. Python, Next.js, PostgreSQL, GitHub Actions.
- [Curio](https://m0nis.com/projects/curio): Personalized reading feed from 275+ sources across 26 topics. Five scheduled jobs (ingestion, digests, source-quality scoring, cleanup, re-engagement); parallel ingestion with per-source timeouts; Postgres full-text search; HMAC-signed digest links. Solo. Next.js, Drizzle, PostgreSQL, Resend.
- [FieldProof](https://m0nis.com/projects/fieldproof): Field photos to verifiable impact reports (Code Cubicle 6.0, team of 4; owned backend and AI pipeline). Postgres job queue and Python worker running CLIP tagging, pgvector search, EXIF GPS site assignment; LLM reports that invent numbers are rejected. 40 tests against a real database. FastAPI, pgvector, LiteLLM.
- [DataPilot](https://m0nis.com/projects/datapilot): Prompt to clean dataset. LLM planning agent runs robots.txt-aware collectors across 9 sources in parallel, then validates, de-duplicates and confidence-scores rows into Postgres. Solo. Next.js, PostgreSQL, Cheerio.
- [Shikshak Saathi](https://m0nis.com/projects/shikshak-saathi): Lesson kits for teachers from an NCERT chapter, in English and Hindi (Hack-e-Awadh 2026, team of 3; frontend and AI pipeline). Next.js, Prisma, Gemini, Sarvam AI.

## Smaller builds

- Remote Browser Control: headless Chromium per session in Docker, CDP screencast over a WebSocket proxy.
- Agent Console: resilient WebSocket streaming client with a pure state-machine core; 60 unit tests.
- triage-bot: CLI agent that explores a repo with capped read-only tools to triage a GitHub issue.
- FolderMage: file organizer with SHA-256 duplicate detection and BullMQ scheduled jobs.
